calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount, f.quantity, w.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), ref AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) qret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT format, coalesce(status,'(store)') status, count(*) lines, sum(net_amount) sold_net, coalesce(sum(refund_net),0) ret_net,
  round(100.0*coalesce(sum(refund_net),0)/sum(net_amount),3) rate, sum(CASE WHEN qret>quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_returned,
  sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ref USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) refund_gt_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_refund,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ret_before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date > f.sale_date + 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) later_than_30,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.product_key <> f.product_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prod_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_net/r.quantity_returned - f.net_amount/f.quantity) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unitprice_mismatch,
 min(r.reason_code), max(r.reason_code), count(DISTINCT r.reason_code) reasons
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS n_lines, round(sum(f.net_amount),2) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS n_days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY CASE l.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Small' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
